tripAdvisorReviews.name: hub by Premier Inn London King's Cross Hotel

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Just back from London celebrating a friend’s special birthday. Stayed here for 1 night and my first experience at a Premier Inn Hub so didn’t really know what to expect. Was seriously impressed, excellent value for money - good sized room (considering price), clean and adequate. Free refreshments, and a good breakfast with plenty of choice. But the gem at this hotel has to be Rita, one of the reception team (although I have to say all of the staff were super friendly and helpful) but Rita went above and beyond. She approached us whilst we were having a drink in the bar, just chatting and asked if we were here for anything special - we told her we were celebrating a birthday and she immediately asked our names, arranged for us to have rooms next to each other and said she would leave a treat for our friend. When we arrived back she had decorated her room with banner, card, treats and all sorts including a bottle of fizz. Rita definitely made our stay a special and memorable one and we would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone. Thank you Rita - our friend was really touched!

reviews.title: Great value hotel
reviews.text: Lovely clean hotel, staying larger double room. Very modern, good value for money and perfect for station and underground. Big shout out for Rita who went above  and beyond to get us rooms next to each other and then a surprise in my room for my big birthday celebration.! Thanks lovely lady, you were a gem x

reviews.title: Looking forward to return visit
reviews.text:
We have just returned home after a lovely stay at the Premier inn hub hotel in Kings Cross. The hotel is in a great location by Kings Cross station and is very clean and well cared for. 
We are looking forward to our return visit. The staff are very helpful and we would like to give a special mention to Rita who was so friendly and kind and an asset to the business

reviews.title: Hubs are Better than premiere Inn main hotel
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay from the time i step in. Staffs were really helpful and friendly. Specially Rita, she is a star. She is very professional and always try her best to provide good service. I will definitely back again i future. Better than main hotels by premiere inn

reviews.title: Great comfortable stay, great location
reviews.text:
First stay for me at this location, but the third time for my colleagues. Great comfortable rooms and great sound insulation.

The best bit was the hospitality extended by the front of house team, especially Rita who made our stay extra special. 

The group from Damilah in North Macedonia say hi!!!
